q: For a quantum state ρ_{AB} of a bipartite system, the strong subadditivity of von Neumann entropy states:
exp: Strong subadditivity (Lieb–Ruskai 1973): S(AB) + S(BC) ≥ S(B) + S(ABC), equivalently I(A;C|B)≥0. This is the deepest inequality in quantum information theory; its proof uses the Lieb concavity theorem. All useful properties of quantum entropy follow from it.
